svg.text: Figure 4.12d Entity Relationship Diagram, Part 4 of 4
Messaging and reviews: shop and customer chat, per-conversation read markers and shop reviews
reference: table drawn in full in another part
Types: ts = timestamptz, num = numeric, int = integer. Each line runs from a foreign key column (crow’s foot) to the table it references (bar), always to that table’s primary key.
Unique (user_id, shop_id, peer_user_id) on conversation_read_state; unique (shop_id, customer_user_id) on shop_reviews, so a customer reviews a shop once.
conversation_read_state.peer_user_id has no foreign key constraint.
